neighbours.label: In environmental and conservation writing, the word introducing a pest, pollutant or wildlife target ('removal of non-native', 'use of DDT', 'concerns about bacteria', 'fight against the beetle'); weaker in the same constructions about non-environmental things.
fire: The crew spent a week pulling up non-native grasses along the river bank.
Residents demanded a ban on the spraying of pesticides near the school.
The lake was closed after reports about algae blooms near the dock.
State foresters continue the battle against the spotted lanternfly.
Gardeners are urged to avoid planting non-native shrubs that spread quickly.
The report linked the decline of bees to the use of neonicotinoids.
Swimmers were warned about high levels of E. coli at the beach.
Volunteers went searching for nesting sea turtles at dawn.
quiet: The crew spent a week painting the railings along the river bank.
Residents demanded a ban on the parking of trucks near the school.
The office was closed after reports about a power outage downtown.
State lawyers continue the battle against the new tax on fuel.
Gardeners are urged to water early in the morning when it is cool.
The report linked the decline of sales to the price of gasoline.
Shoppers were warned about long lines at the mall this weekend.
